# Constitution Ratification

Use this template for PRs that ratify the repository Constitution.

Checklist:

- [ ] Constitution file updated with RATIFICATION_DATE and RatifiedBy
- [ ] Sync Impact Report added to the Constitution
- [ ] `specs/001-amend-constitution/quickstart.md` updated with validation steps
- [ ] Contracts directory updated (if applicable) and schema examples included
- [ ] CI checks added/updated to validate schema compatibility
- [ ] Observability guidance added to docs

Provide a short summary of why this ratification is needed and link to evidence.
